_meta.note: The golden re-extraction regression's fixed subset. It used to be 'every accepted record', which was eight clips; the store is 2446 now, and re-running the kinematic pipeline over all of them would turn a gate that answers in seconds into one nobody runs. A FIXED list, not a sample: the point of a regression is that the same clips answer the same way on every run, so a drift in a divisor or a bone map shows up as the same failure twice rather than a different one each time.
_meta.coverage: Chosen to span what the kinematic half has to get right -- standing, walking, sitting, sit/stand transitions, crouching, kneeling, bending, floor-level crawling and lying, and one airborne clip -- plus two single-pose clips, because 128 of the corpus's records are two frames long and that is the shortest path through every formula.

actions.covers: standing — an idle stand, every channel static
standing — head and torso move under a still stance
single-pose clip — two frames, the shortest a dump can be
walking — a locomotion cycle, both legs dynamic
transition — seated to standing and back
crouching — low carriage on folded legs
kneeling — arms and hands working over a kneel
bending — trunk past horizontal, still on the feet
floor — prone into a stand, the longest state change
airborne — leaves the ground and lands
